articles.title: Nor'easter floods some New Jersey roads and homes as dangerous conditions loom
articles.description:
PROVIDENCE, R.I. (AP) — Thousands were without power on the U.S. East Coast on Friday night as roads flooded in some coastal New Jersey communities, the first major signs of a powerful nor’easter expected to create dangerous conditions through the weekend.
